summary: Recent changes in the libwebrtc build process focus on improving how the code is managed and integrated. Updates to scripts like `vendor-libwebrtc.py` allow it to be called from other Python programs, which enhances flexibility for developers when working with WebRTC, the technology behind video calls. Additionally, renaming and adjusting the scope of certain variables aims to streamline the build process, making it easier to manage local vendoring of the WebRTC library. These enhancements, including a new Python-based version of a build script, are critical for ensuring faster and more efficient development, contributing to overall performance improvements in Firefox. **Users will benefit indirectly from this smoother development workflow as it can lead to quicker updates and features in their browser.**
